info.title: Trindade Massas Operações API
info.description: Generated from the Zod schemas the routes validate with. Never edit the artifact by hand: change the schema and regenerate.

post.summary: Exchange credentials for an access token and a refresh session

200.description: Authenticated. The refresh token is the session and is rotated on every refresh.

400.description: The request body failed validation

401.description: The credentials are wrong, or the account is inactive

post.summary: Rotate a refresh session into a new token pair
post.description: Unauthenticated by design: a client refreshes precisely because its access token has expired. Every failure answers identically so a caller cannot probe whether a token existed, had expired, or had been revoked. Presenting a token that was already rotated away is treated as a leak and revokes the whole session family.

200.description: A new token pair. The presented refresh token is no longer valid.

400.description: The request body failed validation

401.description: The refresh token is unknown, expired, revoked, or its family was revoked

post.summary: End the session this client is holding
post.description: Ends only the session whose refresh token is presented, so logging out on one device leaves other devices signed in. The body is optional: the web client sends none.

200.description: The session was ended. Idempotent: an unknown or already-ended token still succeeds.

400.description: The request body failed validation

get.summary: Read the authenticated user

404.description: The authenticated user no longer exists

get.summary: Read the authenticated user profile

404.description: The authenticated user no longer exists

400.description: The request body failed validation

404.description: The authenticated user no longer exists

post.description: Ends every session of that user, so other devices must authenticate again.

200.description: The password was changed and all sessions were ended

400.description: The body failed validation, or the current password is wrong

404.description: The authenticated user no longer exists

get.summary: Report whether the one-time administrator setup still has to run

200.description: Setup is required only while no user exists at all

post.description: Available only while no user exists. Refused once the installation has an administrator.

400.description: The request body failed validation

409.description: Initial setup is already complete, or could not create the administrator

get.summary: List loading batches newest first, one item per creation date

200.description: One item per batch date, with server-computed lifecycle flags

400.description: The query parameters failed validation

get.summary: List one date's active schedules

200.description: The active schedules for that date, ordered by time slot

400.description: The query parameters failed validation

post.summary: Assign a driver to a time slot
post.description: The fletero limit is deliberately NOT enforced: exceeding three fleteros in a rolling hour is informational, and the server accepts the assignment. The only uniqueness rules the server enforces are that one driver and one vehicle cannot appear twice on the same date.

201.description: The created schedule, projected like a listed one

400.description: The body failed validation, the driver is missing or inactive, or the date already has a deactivated batch

403.description: The date is read-only for this user

404.description: The referenced driver or vehicle does not exist

409.description: That driver or that vehicle is already assigned on this date

patch.summary: Move or reassign a schedule entry

200.description: The updated schedule, projected like a listed one

400.description: The identifier is not a number, or the body failed validation

403.description: Only the creator may edit, and only during the first hour

409.description: That driver or that vehicle is already assigned on this date

delete.description: An Administrador may delete any entry; a Trabalhador only their own.

400.description: The identifier is not a number

403.description: A Trabalhador may only delete their own entry

400.description: The identifier is not a number

patch.summary: Deactivate every active entry of one date

400.description: The date is not in YYYY-MM-DD form

404.description: No active batch on that date

delete.summary: Delete every entry of one date

400.description: The date is not in YYYY-MM-DD form

get.summary: Render the WhatsApp text for one date
get.description: Formatted on the server in Brazilian Portuguese, ascending by time slot. A client must fetch this text rather than reimplement the format.

400.description: The query parameters failed validation

get.summary: List active drivers of both types

post.description: Always creates a `fletero`; company drivers are managed from the admin surface.

400.description: The request body failed validation

get.summary: List active company vehicles
List the configured loading time slots
get.description: Read from the settings table, falling back to the built-in daily slots.

200.description: The configured slots in ascending order

get.summary: List the products each product-check element type offers
get.description: The offer, not a constraint. A report stores any product name -- the server echoes what it is given -- so this is the list a client puts in front of an operator, served here so a second client does not have to duplicate the constants the SPA keeps.

200.description: The two lists, one per product-check element type

get.summary: List the active report categories with their tasks

200.description: Active categories, each carrying its active tasks

get.summary: List reports within a period

200.description: Reports in the period, newest first. This endpoint passes no actor, so its items carry no lifecycle flags.

400.description: The query parameters failed validation
The body failed validation, or a report already exists for that shift and date

get.summary: List report history with pagination and filters

200.description: History items, each with its server-computed lifecycle flags

400.description: The query parameters failed validation

get.summary: Report the shift the server detects from its own clock
get.description: Detected in São Paulo time: 18:30 onwards is the tarde shift, and 06:00 onwards the noite shift. A client must ask rather than compute this, so a device with a wrong clock still agrees with the server.

get.summary: Read one report with its items and temperature readings

200.description: The report, with lifecycle flags when the caller is allowed to change it

400.description: The identifier is not a number

patch.summary: Replace the contents of a report

400.description: The identifier is not a number, or the body failed validation

403.description: The report is outside its edit window, or belongs to another user

400.description: The identifier is not a number
The identifier is not a number

get.summary: Render the WhatsApp text for one report
get.description: Formatted on the server in Brazilian Portuguese. A client must fetch this text rather than reimplement the format.

400.description: The report does not carry every temperature reading its catalog requires

get.summary: List the photos attached to a report

post.summary: Attach a photo to a report
post.description: Multipart with the file in a field named "file". Only JPEG, PNG and WebP are accepted, the declared type must match the file content, and a report accepts at most five photos.

201.description: The stored photo, with its authenticated and its public URL

400.description: No file was sent, or the file was empty

403.description: The report is outside its edit window

409.description: The report already carries five photos

413.description: The file exceeds the 5 MB limit

415.description: The file is not JPEG, PNG or WebP, or its content does not match the declared type

403.description: The report is outside its edit window

get.summary: Fetch one photo
get.description: Requires the Bearer token, so a native client has to attach it. Prefer the public link when the photo is meant to be pasted into a chat.

404.description: No such photo, or its file is missing from disk

get.summary: Fetch a photo by its public token, without authentication
get.description: Documented as implemented, not as intended: this route requires a token of at least sixteen characters while the server issues twelve-hex-character tokens, so it answers 404 in practice. The short route `/p/{token}` is the one that works and is what `publicUrl` points at.

get.summary: List every report category
get.description: Admits Administrador and Trabalhador: those are the only two roles this API defines, so the only refusal from the guard is a missing or invalid token, with 401. This is the management view, so inactive categories are included.

200.description: Every category, active or not, in sort order

post.description: Administrador only: a Trabalhador is refused with 403, and a missing or invalid token with 401. A category needs a name in Portuguese or Spanish; when only one is sent the server translates the other.

400.description: The request body failed validation

patch.description: Administrador only: a Trabalhador is refused with 403, and a missing or invalid token with 401. Every field is optional; only the ones sent are changed.

400.description: The identifier is not a number, or the body failed validation

delete.description: Administrador only: a Trabalhador is refused with 403, and a missing or invalid token with 401. Refused with 400 when something still references the category, which is why deactivating it is the safer edit.

400.description: The identifier is not a number, or the category is referenced elsewhere

get.summary: List report tasks with their category name
get.description: Admits Administrador and Trabalhador: those are the only two roles this API defines, so the only refusal from the guard is a missing or invalid token, with 401. The tasks carry their category's `category_name`, which only this listing joins. A Trabalhador is shown only the active tasks; an Administrador sees every task, active or not.

200.description: The tasks, each with the name of its category

post.description: Admits Administrador and Trabalhador: those are the only two roles this API defines, so the only refusal from the guard is a missing or invalid token, with 401. A task created by a Trabalhador is recorded against that user, which is what lets them later edit and delete it; one created by an Administrador is unattributed. A task inherits its `task_type` from the category it is created under, so the request sends a `category_id` rather than a type.

201.description: The created task, without the category name that only the list carries

400.description: The request body failed validation

patch.description: Admits Administrador and Trabalhador: those are the only two roles this API defines, so the only refusal from the guard is a missing or invalid token, with 401. A Trabalhador may edit only a task they created, and may not set `is_active`; both are refused with 403. An Administrador has neither limit.

200.description: The updated task, without the category name that only the list carries

400.description: The identifier is not a number, or the body failed validation

403.description: A Trabalhador tried to set is_active, or to edit another user's task

delete.description: Admits Administrador and Trabalhador: those are the only two roles this API defines, so the only refusal from the guard is a missing or invalid token, with 401. A Trabalhador may delete only a task they created, and is refused with 403 otherwise. An Administrador may delete any task.

400.description: The identifier is not a number, or the task is referenced elsewhere

403.description: A Trabalhador tried to delete another user's task

get.summary: List drivers
get.description: Admits Administrador and Trabalhador: those are the only two roles this API defines, so the only refusal from the guard is a missing or invalid token, with 401. A Trabalhador is shown only the active drivers; an Administrador sees every driver, active or not. Unlike every other admin resource, drivers have no delete route: a driver is deactivated instead.

200.description: The drivers, active and -- for an Administrador -- inactive

post.description: Admits Administrador and Trabalhador: those are the only two roles this API defines, so the only refusal from the guard is a missing or invalid token, with 401. A Trabalhador may create only a `fletero` driver and is refused with 403 for a `casa` one; an Administrador may create either. A driver created by a Trabalhador is recorded against them.

400.description: The request body failed validation

403.description: A Trabalhador tried to create a casa driver

patch.description: Admits Administrador and Trabalhador: those are the only two roles this API defines, so the only refusal from the guard is a missing or invalid token, with 401. A Trabalhador may edit only a `fletero` driver they created, may not set `is_active`, and may not change the `driver_type` to `casa`; each of those is refused with 403. An Administrador has none of those limits.

400.description: The identifier is not a number, or the body failed validation

403.description: A Trabalhador tried to set is_active, change the type, or edit another user's driver

get.summary: List company vehicles
get.description: Administrador only: a Trabalhador is refused with 403, and a missing or invalid token with 401. This is the management view, so inactive vehicles are included.

post.description: Administrador only: a Trabalhador is refused with 403, and a missing or invalid token with 401. A description and a license plate are both required.

400.description: The request body failed validation

patch.description: Administrador only: a Trabalhador is refused with 403, and a missing or invalid token with 401. Every field is optional; only the ones sent are changed.

400.description: The identifier is not a number, or the body failed validation

delete.description: Administrador only: a Trabalhador is refused with 403, and a missing or invalid token with 401. Refused with 400 when something still references the vehicle, which is why deactivating it is the safer edit.

400.description: The identifier is not a number, or the vehicle is referenced elsewhere

get.summary: Read the configured loading time slots
get.description: Administrador only: a Trabalhador is refused with 403, and a missing or invalid token with 401. The same setting the loading module reads under `GET /api/loading/time-slots`, falling back to the built-in daily slots when no setting row exists.

200.description: The configured slots in ascending order

put.summary: Replace the configured loading time slots
put.description: Administrador only: a Trabalhador is refused with 403, and a missing or invalid token with 401. Replaces the whole list; at least one slot is required.

200.description: The slots as stored, in ascending order

400.description: The request body failed validation

get.summary: List users with their role name
get.description: Administrador only: a Trabalhador is refused with 403, and a missing or invalid token with 401. The projection omits `password_hash` and `updated_at`, and the `role_name` arrives from a join, so every listed user carries it.

200.description: Every user, with the joined role name

post.description: Administrador only: a Trabalhador is refused with 403, and a missing or invalid token with 401. The password is stored hashed, and a duplicate username is refused with 400.

201.description: The created user, without its password hash

400.description: The body failed validation, or the username is already taken

patch.description: Administrador only: a Trabalhador is refused with 403, and a missing or invalid token with 401. An administrator editing their own account may change their details or password, but may not change their own `role_id` or `is_active`; that is refused with 403.

200.description: The updated user, without its password hash

400.description: The identifier is not a number, the body failed validation, or the username is taken

403.description: Administrador only, or an administrator changing their own role or active flag

delete.description: Administrador only: a Trabalhador is refused with 403, and a missing or invalid token with 401. An administrator may not delete their own account; that is refused with 403.

400.description: The identifier is not a number, or the user is referenced elsewhere

403.description: Administrador only, or an administrator deleting their own account

get.summary: Read the paginated audit log
get.description: Administrador only: a Trabalhador is refused with 403, and a missing or invalid token with 401. Ordered newest first, and filterable by action, entity type and user id. A log row whose authoring user was deleted keeps its entry with a null `user_id` and `display_name`.

200.description: One page of audit rows with its totals

400.description: The query parameters failed validation

get.summary: Read the operational dashboard summary
get.description: Every count is computed server-side, and the date-based ones use the São Paulo day rather than the device clock.

200.description: The summary counts, and the progress pairs for two fixed categories

get.summary: Report that the process is serving
get.description: Liveness only: it does not check the database, so a client uses it to tell a dead host from a failing request, and nothing more.

get.summary: List the active users the history filters offer

200.description: Active users, ordered by display name

get.summary: Fetch a photo by its short public link
get.description: This is the route the WhatsApp exports point at, and the only public photo route that works: the token is the credential and needs no header, which is what makes it pasteable into a chat.

404.description: No such photo token, or its file is missing from disk
